name: B10-0196/2026 (Renew) – Supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position ahead of Armenia's parliamentary elections on 7 June 2026. It supports Armenia's authorities in holding free and fair elections and warns that Russia is trying to interfere through disinformation, cyberattacks and economic pressure. It asks the European Union to send a new mission to help Armenia counter these threats, to give more money to Armenian civil society and independent media, and to work with online platforms to remove manipulative content.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament asks the EU to launch a support mission and increase funding.
- **Who it affects:** Armenia's voters, candidates, journalists, civil society groups and media outlets.
- **What happens next:** The EU and its member states decide whether to act on these requests before the June elections.
